MeetingIdentification.name: Meeting Identification
MeetingIdentification.definition: Identification assigned to the general meeting by the party that provides the meeting notification. It must be unique to the party providing the notification.

IssuerMeetingIdentification.name: Issuer Meeting Identification
IssuerMeetingIdentification.definition: Identification assigned to the meeting by the issuer. It must be unique for the issuer.

MeetingDateAndTime.name: Meeting Date And Time
MeetingDateAndTime.definition: Date and time at which the meeting will take place.

EntitlementFixingDate.name: Entitlement Fixing Date
EntitlementFixingDate.definition: Date at which the positions are struck to record which parties will receive the entitlement, for example, record date, book close date.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of meeting for which instructions are sent.

Location.name: Location
Location.definition: Place of the company meeting for the scheduled meeting date.

Issuer.name: Issuer
Issuer.definition: Institution that is the issuer of the security to which the meeting applies.
